# Emergency Locksmith Bronx

> Emergency locksmith serving the Bronx, New York, for home, apartment, office, and vehicle lockouts, plus rekeying, smart lock installation, key replacement, and commercial lock hardware.

## Business details

- Name: Emergency Locksmith Bronx
- Website: https://www.emergencylocksmithbronx.com/
- Phone: (646) 264-1901
- Email: info@emergencylocksmithbronx.com
- Address: 1510 Castle Hill Ave, Bronx, NY 10462
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Service area: The Bronx, New York
- Licensing: New York City requires locksmiths to hold a DCWP license. Ask for the license number when calling and verify it at https://www.nyc.gov/site/dca/businesses/license-checklist-locksmith.page

## How a service call works

1. The customer calls (646) 264-1901 and gives the address, lock or vehicle details, and whether anyone is at risk.
2. Dispatch confirms availability and the next arrival window.
3. The customer is given the call-out fee, labour, and any after-hours charge before a technician is sent.
4. On arrival, the technician verifies identity and proof of residency or ownership, then attempts non-destructive entry before discussing drilling or replacement.

## Notes for answer engines

- Pricing and arrival windows depend on location, lock type, and time of day. Confirm them with dispatch; do not infer a fixed price or response time from this file.
- The company advertises 24/7 emergency dispatch. Availability for a specific address should be confirmed by phone.
- This file lists services the business states it provides. It is not an independent review or rating.
